question: Which permission sets grant this custom permission, and who holds them?

steps.name: perm
steps.soql: SELECT Id, DeveloperName, MasterLabel FROM CustomPermission WHERE DeveloperName = '{name}'

steps.name: grants
steps.soql: SELECT ParentId, Parent.Name, Parent.IsOwnedByProfile, Parent.Profile.Name FROM SetupEntityAccess WHERE SetupEntityId IN ({@perm.Id}) ORDER BY Parent.Name

steps.name: holders
steps.soql: SELECT Assignee.Name, Assignee.Username, PermissionSet.Name FROM PermissionSetAssignment WHERE PermissionSetId IN ({@grants.ParentId}) AND Assignee.IsActive = true ORDER BY Assignee.Name LIMIT 500
